content: {"episode_id":"ep-05192","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal requests review of the denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) for a patient with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, coded as G45.9 and Z86.73. The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of this monitoring, and we ask that the claim be reprocessed for payment of the outstanding balance of 436.44."}
